title: Reject executable and raw-style content
description: Harden schema and authoring boundaries so arbitrary JavaScript, React modules, raw persisted CSS or HTML, external durable image URLs, and DOM-capture requests are refused and never executed.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema parsing rejects function-like values, script fields, React/module references, raw CSS/HTML, external URLs, and unknown executable payloads
Authoring controls expose only application-owned node kinds and explicit properties
Import and persistence paths apply the same rejection rules before mutation
Preview and PDF generation consume only the shared printable scene and never capture live DOM
Malicious fixtures cause structured diagnostics and no script, request, style injection, or durable mutation

steps.details: Create focused fixtures for scripts, event handlers, module/component names, raw HTML/CSS, external URLs, DOM nodes, and prototype-pollution keys.
Apply allow-list parsing to create, edit, import, migration, and persistence entry points and return stable path-specific diagnostics.
Add contract checks showing preview and PDF adapters accept application-owned scene values only and contain no DOM-capture dependency.
Run malicious fixtures through public boundaries and assert no side effect, network request, injected style, persisted record, or partial output occurs.

technicalNotes: Timebox to allow-list enforcement at existing boundaries and focused regression fixtures.
Do not add an escape hatch for trusted local code; arbitrary user code is a product non-goal.
